name: communitypass
description: CommunityPass — WhatsApp community membership manager for Nigerian creators (MVP)

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter ./packages/** run build && pnpm -r --filter ./apps/** run build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @communitypass/shared run build && pnpm --filter @communitypass/core run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @communitypass/shared run test && pnpm --filter @communitypass/core run test && pnpm --filter @communitypass/api run test
